title: The First Scar
subtitle: Carve, learn, arrange, commit
text: At Degree 4, ask the Vicar for Masons Respite. The remote Vein-Mason gives a strongest-tendency pattern, blank scar, matching catalyst, and knapper if needed. His Cerebral Scarring Station supervises your first lesson until you learn the scar; later work requires your own crafted station. Load the purple stencil, trace its cells in red, then carve. Place the Scar in an empty Iron Brazier with ordinary use. Blood Projection lights it for 50 mL. Hold Blood Absorption on the lit offering until it dissolves; learning costs 100 mL. Sneaking retrieves offerings. Craft Runic Motif Paper from Paper, Charcoal, and Sanguine Formation. Select the known scar at the Mason's Effigy and press Prepare. Place the paper, then project 500 mL per selected scar and collect the prepared Pattern. Anyone charging must know every selected scar and have room for the loadout. Selection stays fixed while charging; stopping and resuming retains the partial charge. Breaking the Effigy returns its paper, not spent blood. Commit the prepared Pattern in a lit Brazier with held Blood Absorption for 50 mL. Only this completed cycle proves the D4 Main assignment. Cerebral scars are learned routes, not worn items. The Fungal Implantation Pylon installs separate cultivated fungal scars.
